The man behind the camera

20 years in cinema.
Now with you, every day.

Directed the feature films ‘Dabang Sarkar’ and ‘Vidyapeeth’, and served as post-production head, editor and DI colorist on 15+ feature films. Founded Indian Films Academy in 2019, where 100+ students have trained in camera acting and now work in the entertainment industry. His own acting method is called Yogesh CineAct.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Who is Yogesh Chaitanya?

Yogesh Chaitanya (formerly Yogesh Mishrra / Yogesh Raj Mishra) is a Lucknow-based film director, acting coach, editor and DI colorist. He directed ‘Dabang Sarkar’ and ‘Vidyapeeth’, headed post-production on 15+ films, and founded Indian Films Academy, Lucknow.

What is Cinekar Vlogs?

Cinekar Vlogs is Yogesh Chaitanya's daily vlog channel showing real life inside Indian Films Academy's hostel and classes, behind-the-scenes of shoots, and the actors of Raja Ka Baja.

How often are new vlogs posted?

A new vlog goes up every day on the YouTube channel @cinekarvlogs and appears on cinekar.com within an hour.

How do I join Indian Films Academy?

Indian Films Academy in Vardan Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow offers courses in camera acting, film direction and film editing. Admission details are on indianfilmsacademy.com.

How can brands collaborate or book a shoot?

Email yogeshcineact@gmail.com or use the WhatsApp button on this site.
